title: Finalize CCP2 wire and activation contract
description: Finalize the exact wire profile required by CCP2-002/003/004. Specify non-ambiguous revision/mode discrimination, authenticated schedule/root/DODAG/generation/plan/profile binding, activation and expiry, common-window units/geometry, receiver-owned channel and RX commitment, identified TX grants, actual radio capability, replay/unknown/duplicate handling and mixed-legacy rejection. Encode full channel indices and canonical variable-length masks per CCP2-005/006. Reuse existing standing beacon/Announce/assignment mechanisms without a per-packet reservation protocol; do not repurpose SCHC v3 or link-domain v1. Demonstrate that bootstrap/control records and responses fit the selected admitted PHY/operating basis; otherwise keep that combination disabled. Resolve next-hop versus remote-origin metadata and operation-specific hash preimages; coordinate worker6-xzen, 0aod, b7z9.22/.23/.74 and qe1t instead of rebuilding their completed helpers.
acceptance_criteria: All semantic fields in spec/02b-ccp-receiver-aware.md have exact bounded encoding and authenticated ownership; allocation/absence/unknown and revision transitions specified; independent worked bytes available; full-frame/control-budget feasibility checked; three independent correctness/security/robustness reviews with findings filed and resolved. No on-air activation or compliance claim before downstream gates.
